title: South Korea Stock Market May Run Out Of Steam
text:
South Korea Stock Market May Run Out Of Steam November 19, 2018, 06:01:00 South Korea stock market has finished higher in three straight sessions, collecting almost 35 points or 1.6 percent along the way. The KOSPI now rests just above the 2,100-point plateau although investors figure to lock in gains on Tuesday.
 KOSPI finished modestly higher on Monday as gains from the industrials and oil companies were offset by weakness from the financials and technology stocks.
For the day, the index picked up 8.16 points or 0.39 percent to finish at 2,100.56 after trading between 2,089.37 and 2,111.39. Volume was 268.93 million shares worth 4.61 trillion won.
Among the actives, SK Innovation surged 3.05 percent, while S-Oil climbed 0.45 percent, POSCO perked 1.96 percent, Hyundai Motor dropped 1.46 percent, Kia Motors advanced 0.68 percent, Samsung Electronics shed 0.80 percent, SK Hynix lost 0.43 percent, LG Electronics dipped 0.28 percent, Shinhan Financial slid 0.82 percent and KB Financial Group fell 0.42 percent.
